about_short_description.short_description: LevelBlue is a cybersecurity company that offers network security and endpoint management services.

product.name: Managed Detection & Response
product.description: A 24/7/365 service that detects, investigates, hunts, and responds to threats across an organization’s environment using security telemetry, AI-assisted analysis, and expert operations.

product.name: Managed Cloud Security
product.description: A managed service for protecting cloud assets, enforcing security policies, and operating security controls across hybrid cloud environments.

product.name: Managed Network Security
product.description: Managed protection and monitoring for network infrastructure, providing visibility and security control across enterprise digital environments.

product.name: Incident Readiness & Response
product.description: A preparedness and response service providing 24/7 breach assistance, forensic investigation, containment guidance, and incident reporting.

product.name: Cyber Advisory
product.description: Consulting services that assess cybersecurity risk, support compliance objectives, and guide security program improvement and transformation.

product.name: Exposure Management
product.description: A service for discovering, prioritizing, and reducing vulnerabilities and other exposures across an organization’s attack surface.
